answer_4.quote: Subjects are recruited through the Amazon Mechanical Turk platform to interact with our systems ... After each dialogue, the subject rates the system as successful if they think they received all the information required and all constraints were met. The subjects rate each system on a 5 point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Subjects judge whether the system was successful (all information and constraints satisfied) and provide a 5‑point Likert rating of the system.
